prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
**BBS Insurance** looks like a strong first call for a self-employed Kansas City, MO resident. It specifically serves self-employed people and 1099 contractors, and says it compares ACA Marketplace and private plans and checks subsidy eligibility. Its North Kansas City office is at **1327 Burlington St., North Kansas City, MO 64116**; phone **(816) 205-4664**. [BBS’s Kansas City page](https://bbs-insurance.com/service-areas/kansas-city/) describes its services and includes client reviews, though those are not an independent measure of quality.

I’d also compare with **AIS Health Advisors**, which says it helps self-employed clients with individual and family ACA Marketplace coverage and subsidy questions: **(913) 333-8627**. [AIS Health Advisors](https://aishealthadvisors.com/)

Before choosing, ask each broker:
- Which insurers and plans can you compare for my **Missouri** address?
- Will you check my doctors, prescriptions, and estimated annual costs—not just the monthly premium?
- Can you help estimate my Marketplace subsidy based on self-employment income?
- Is your help free to me, and do you receive commissions from insurers?

For ACA coverage, you can also compare plans or enroll directly at [HealthCare.gov](https://www.healthcare.gov/). A broker can help, but you don’t have to use one.
